name: Aim-Calibrating Sensors
description: A forehead sensor compensating for range, wind, cover, shields and poor light. Each mote removes one die of environmental/situational penalty from a ranged attack; every 2 motes cancel one point of difficulty or negate one subtracted success. Does not offset wound, fear, or multiple-action penalties.

name: Paramagnetic Tether Beam
description: A shaped force ray (range Strength x 10 yards) that crudely manipulates objects with telekinesis, substituting Essence for Dexterity and Strength (finesse Abilities still apply). Can grab or recall weapons, disarm (Essence + Brawl/Martial Arts, not attuned artifacts), suspend or winch the Exalt. One beam at a time.

name: Essence Pulse Cannon

submodules.name: Discreet
submodules.description: Cannon hidden in eye or palm; magical detection while inactive is at +1 difficulty, and when active it betrays itself only like a 1-3 mote anima.

submodules.name: Guidance Ray
submodules.description: A tracer beam aiming exactly where the cannon will fire: +3 accuracy, but targets who see the beam gain one die to dodge/parry the shot. Toggle reflexively for free.

submodules.name: Internal Battery
submodules.description: An 8-mote Personal Essence reserve usable only to fire the cannon; restoring one mote is a simple action costing 2 motes from the reservoir. Only one battery.

submodules.name: Precision Beam
submodules.description: Fire a piercing ray: -2 raw damage but piercing. Not with detonation or shockwave.

submodules.name: Shockwave
submodules.description: Spread the pulse: max one level of damage, but the target is hurled one yard per raw-damage die and suffers knockdown unless a Dexterity + Athletics or Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty 2) succeeds.

submodules.name: Stunning Bolt
submodules.description: Fire a non-lethal pulse for 3B per mote; a target reduced to Incapacitated ignores further damage (no lethal spillover).

submodules.name: Detonation
submodules.description: 1L per mote (2B with Stunning Bolt) to the struck target, plus a one-yard-radius blast dealing the base damage, losing one die per further yard. Requires Essence 3.

submodules.name: Essence Dampening Bolt
submodules.description: No physical injury; magical beings hemorrhage 1 mote per level of 'damage' (lethal roll + Essence, soak only permanent Essence); drained motes flare the victim's anima. Requires Essence 3.

submodules.name: Energy Drain
submodules.description: Variant of Essence Dampening Bolt whose bled motes fly back to the Exalt's own pool. Requires Essence 4.

submodules.name: Pattern Disruptor
submodules.description: 1A per mote (other base-damage bonuses halved); anything slain disintegrates, spirits are annihilated, mortal souls obliterated unless soulgemmed. Not with detonation/shockwave/stunning bolt. Requires Essence 4.

submodules.name: Siege Devastator
submodules.description: Unfolds over the forearm (rate 1, -2 mobility, stealth impossible) to add one die to the base damage per mote (so 3L per mote unmodified). Requires Essence 5.

description: A torso reactor firing energy bolts the color of the Exalt's anima: range (Essence x 50) yards, accuracy +1, rate (Essence x installations), damage 2L per mote (max Strength + Essence motes). Each shot is a supplemental Charm use; bolts may be dodged or parried.

name: Interceptor Spark Emitter
description: Shoot down projectiles. Mode one (2m): parry one missile within (Essence x 50) yards at Dexterity + Archery + Essence (+1 die with Guidance Ray; +3 difficulty to defend others). Mode two (3m): a full-parry trance against every perceived ranged attack, usable only if the Exalt has not yet acted. Size-limited to javelins below Essence 6.

name: Pulseweb Entanglement Burst
description: The cannon fires an Essence net (Dexterity + Archery, range Essence x 20). On a hit, contest Strength + Essence; winning paralyzes the target in a crystalline aura (as a clinch), re-contested each turn for one unsoakable bashing per turn held. The aura reduces attacks against the victim by Essence and shocks melee attackers for Essence dice of piercing bashing.

name: Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator
description: A forearm compartment extrudes a missile of raw Essence (arrow, throwing dagger, throwing baton or chakram) that dissipates after (Essence) turns. Arrows auto-nock into a carried bow. Essence 6+ Exalts make warstrider-scaled ammunition.

name: Repeating Pneumatic Bow

submodules.name: Guidance Ray
submodules.description: Duplicates the Guidance Ray submodule of Essence Pulse Cannon for this weapon.

submodules.name: Internal Magazine
submodules.description: A helical magazine storing up to 6 replicator arrows in stasis (they don't disintegrate until the turn they're fired); feed from replicator or magazine.

description: A forearm-mounted steam bow: base damage Strength (plus ammunition), accuracy Essence, range (100 x Essence) yards, unlimited rate, fed by the Protosynthetic Ammunition Replicator. Firing it is not a Charm activation. Loudly obvious when active.

name: Subluminous Onslaught Missile
description: The bow fires a crystal spike: accuracy Essence, range one mile, base damage [Strength + (Essence x 2)]L, piercing, unparryable without a stunt/Charm. It bores through a struck target (losing one die) and continues in a line; a concussive wave knocks human-sized victims back one foot per post-soak die.

name: Hundredfold Strafing Methodology
description: The deployed bow sprays Essence darts across an arc up to 90 degrees. Roll Dexterity + Archery once, applied to every target in the swath (friend or foe); darts have range increment 100 yards and base lethal damage Essence, persisting to end of turn.

name: Transmodal Rapid Targeting System
description: Neural vector-modulators let one projectile strike multiple targets, or a near-simultaneous volley of separate missiles. Mode one (3m): a single missile attacks up to (Essence + 1) targets in succession (full pool each, no target twice), optionally returning to hand for 1 mote. Mode two: release several different missiles under the same rules, each needing its own ammunition.

name: Dedicated Harmonic Targeting
description: Imprints a target's Essence signature on a fired projectile, which dematerializes to ignore all intervening cover and cannot hit bystanders, rematerializing to strike only the intended target (armor still applies). Can attack through a wall if the Exalt can sense the victim beyond it.
